definitions: Be entitled to a particular privilege, benefit, or eligibility by fulfilling a necessary condition.
Become officially recognised as a practitioner of a particular profession or occupation after undertaking a course of study or examination.
Add a reservation or limitation to (a statement or opinion); make less absolute.
Reach a necessary standard for a competition.
Make (something) suitable for a particular purpose or to meet a particular standard.
examples: She qualified as a doctor last year.
I want to qualify my statement.
They qualified for the World Cup.
The new system qualifies the data.
